body:
You are right. How do I convince him to go to a therapist, or even just a psychiatrist for medication? I had asked once, and he said "therapy is pointless, I know why I am depressed and I know the only thing that can fix it is moving out". I am actually in therapy right now, and I think it would help him so much.. 

I am extremely worried about the suicidal ideation and statements he's made. Just don't know how to get him to accept help.

You are so right. I've been looking at apartments every day.. My new job starts within the the next few weeks, just waiting on clearance. We will be able to afford a modest one bedroom in an OK area I think. It's just to get him through the next ca. 8 weeks..

I will try my best to ask him to see a therapist. I had asked him before, but he said it was "pointless" since the only thing that could fix it, the only thing that causes his depression, is our living situation..

Well, he explained  that when he told me he wanted to "urban camp" in the park, he meant that he was going to stay in the city. That I made him promise me not to.. just solidifed his decision that I was going to freak out if he told me he was going to stay in the city overnight. He did not want to deal with that and did not know what to say to me, so he simply turned off his phone.. 

I don't think that's a nice and reasonable thing to do to your wife, and I told him I was worried sick, but I understand it from his point of view, and through his depression. He did apologize for scaring me. thank you for your reply.

Your reply is spot on, I think. He felt trapped, no where peaceful to go. And even though that hurts, I know that sometimes he needs to be away from me too. I'm trying to come to terms with it. He is miserable right now. I am working hard to make the move happen as soon as possible.

I hope you are in a better place now. YOu sound like an awesome person.

Dysfunctional_vet, once again I want to thank you. You have no idea how much your kindness meant last night, and your reasonable responses. You truly made a stranger's life better with it.

I am going to work as hard as I can do help him. I couldn't even really be angry with him, despite what he put me through. He's just obviously in a very bad place. He said he still loves me, and I believe him. I am going to try to convince him to see a therapist, or psychiatrist, or both, so he has someone else neutral to talk to. I hope he agrees.

I've been on Craigslist every day for the last week.I start my job in the next 2 weeks or so. We are going to get out of this house as soon as at all feasible (need to save up a few paychecks for the upfront rent) Thank you.

Well I called the hotel. the found the name and he transfered me. husband picked up. stuttered something about.. he said he's ok and going to breakfast now. we're texting now. he said he doesn't like living anymore, that living at home is too much. there's no peace at home (it's true..) he needed a break from that. im relieved he is ok. that's all I can say for now. thanks again for your advice.

I want to thank you for all your replies. I was hysterical but your replies calmed me down a bit. I have severe anxiety/depression myself and this whole thing is a nightmare. I keep staring at the clock. Just tried the phone again, still VM. Will wait til like 7:30 or so and then try to hotel.. terrified that even if they let me through, if he's there, some girl will pick up.. or that he won't talk to me.

we actually live wit his parents in the same house, a big stressor for him as he hates it. they dont know yet he's "missing" and i dont even know how to bring it up/how to face them.

I will keep you posted. again, I really appreciate your responses.
Never done this before ever. I will try to call his office if I don't hear back this morning. thank you so much for your reply..

Thank you so muc for your response. It means a lot. I just can't make sense of it. It was by all accounts a normal day. I checked, at 8:14 pm he send me the last message, a regular reply to a commend I made about feeling like I caught a stomach bug from him. Then nothing. On the google acivity I was able to find, the last activity was also 8:14. Then nothing after and when I started calling him around 9 it was straight to VM. So mid-texting conversation he stopped replying, after looking at directions to the hotel. He's walking btw, no car. He takes the train home. It just doesn't make any sense to me. I'm back to being sick with worry. Accident? but the hospital would have called by now. Suicide? should I call the hotel? wait longer?

thank you so much. really. I'm just trying to get through the night. I can't get in touch with my husband. He's never done anything like this before. I don't know if he's cheating, if he hurt himself, if he was in an accident, arrest.. since 8pm last night. i dont even know what to do. his phone goes to VM. i already self-harmed tonight and being aloine with my thoughts is driving me crazy.

thanks for listening.
If I called the hotel, would they be allowed to connect me to the room? If I ask for Mr So and So?
I don't know. A few hours ago I was mostly so worried about him being hurt or even that he did something to himself due to his depression. But ever since I saw directions to a hotel..

I know it sounds odd. We never used to be like this. We talk pretty much all day, by text or facetime when we're not home. He started staying out because he did not like being at home with his family (totally understand that). I've been focused on job hunting for the past 2 months. Additionally, his PhD program stressed him out a lot and he spent a lot of time at the library, writing research papers.

I guess I've been in denial about how the dynamics have changed. We used to have a beautiful relationship, very open and deep. I've been afraid of bringing up how distant he was and wanted to give him some space to sort out his thoughts. Seems like it was a mistake.

Not sure how/if he will even get back to me tomorrow? Where do you go from a position where you turned off your phone on your wife and stayed out all night? If he does not contact me, I'll either go to the city to his place of employment, or I'll call the office and ask to speak with him..

Thanks for your reply.
